metadata.title: Aira — Post-Quantum P2P Messenger
metadata.description: Aira is a decentralized messenger with hybrid post-quantum cryptography. No servers, no phone numbers, no compromises.

hero.subtitle: Aira is a decentralized messenger with hybrid post-quantum cryptography. No servers, no phone numbers, no compromises.

features.title: Superpowers
features.subtitle: Every detail designed to protect your freedom to communicate

quantum.title: Quantum-resistant encryption
quantum.description: Hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519 cryptography. Both algorithms must be broken simultaneously — protection against quantum computers today.

p2p.title: Genuine P2P
p2p.description: No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers. Every user is a network node. Messages travel directly over QUIC.

metadata.title: Invisible metadata
metadata.description: Pairwise pseudonyms for each contact. Even the relay doesn't know who you talk to. Padding on all packets hides message sizes.

global.title: Works everywhere
global.description: REALITY camouflage, obfs4, Tor, CDN fallback. Pluggable transports defeat DPI even in the most censored regions.

fullMessenger.title: A full messenger
fullMessenger.description: Reactions, replies, editing, disappearing messages, file transfers, groups up to 100 members, bots — all encrypted.

multiplatform.title: Multi-platform
multiplatform.description: CLI, desktop (Linux/macOS/Windows), Android. Up to 5 linked devices with sync through a seed phrase.

security.title: Under the hood
security.subtitle: 100% Rust. Zero unsafe code in the cryptographic core. Every key is isolated and zeroized after use.
security.vsSignal: Signal uses servers, requires a phone number, and doesn't have post-quantum protection on every message. Aira is P2P + SPQR ratchet.
security.vsSession: Session uses onion routing through Oxen servers. Aira is direct P2P without intermediate servers and with full PQ encryption.
security.vsSimpleX: SimpleX relies on relay servers for delivery. Aira works directly, and relay is only a fallback for NAT traversal.
